summary: Full end-to-end testing of MyNews Hindi AI news app (backend + frontend). Backend: 11/11 pytest tests passed including fact-protection checks on both /api/fetch-news and /api/manual-upload (numbers/dates like 40, 300, 500, 80, 2025 and 1,384 kilometer, 320 km/h, 250 runs, 145 runs, 42,000 spectators, 5 February 2025 preserved verbatim). Hindi Devanagari present in headline+article, images returned as data:image/jpeg;base64 with 'MyNews' watermark baked in. Approve/reject/edit/settings all working. Frontend: Home shows 6 published cards + 7 category filters; article detail shows Hindi headline, watermarked image ('MyNews' visible bottom-right in red badge), Fact Shield section with preserved fact chips, and article body. Admin dashboard: tabs (pending/published/rejected) switch, fetch-news-btn and manual-upload-btn work with real clicks, watermark-settings-btn opens modal, approve-article-btn actually publishes (published count went 3->5, pending 2->1). Manual upload modal submit ran the full AI engine and produced a Hindi rewrite with all facts preserved and watermarked image. Contrary to E1's earlier note, synthetic clicks DID trigger React handlers via Playwright (no overlay interception). No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: model 'gpt-5.4' and 'gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview' are non-standard model IDs; they work through the Emergent LLM proxy per user's choice, but hardcoding new model names in code (line 121, 138) could break silently if proxy renames them. Consider making model names env-configurable.
seed_data uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') (FastAPI); acceptable for now, but lifespan handlers are the modern pattern.

manual-upload URL-fetch path uses requests (sync) inside async endpoint on line 293 — for a real link this will block the event loop for up to 12s. Fine for demo but should be moved to a thread executor or use httpx.AsyncClient.
add_watermark and image decoding also run on the event loop (CPU-bound). Under load consider run_in_executor.
No pagination on /api/articles (to_list(1000)); OK for MVP.
Settings uses collection.update_one with _id='global' — the Article response_model excludes _id fine, but consistent to always project it out.
seed_data_creation: Startup seed inserts 3 published Hindi articles automatically (SEED_ARTICLES). Verified 3 seeded on cold start; +2 fetch-news drafts were approved during test, published count reached 5.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). AI calls take ~15-40s each; use timeout=180s. All data-testids referenced in review request are present and functional on the deployed preview URL. Real Playwright clicks work — no visual-edit overlay interception observed. Test data cleanup deletes articles with 'Test upload' or 'OpenAI' in source_title. Settings watermark test restores original value.
